direction_reversal_table.integrated_interpretation: Raw cross-region transfer was below chance; unsupervised adaptation recovered part of the discrimination loss; a large gap to within-region performance remained. Feature-level univariate AUC direction reversals indicate that marginal feature-label relationships are not stable across regions, a pattern consistent with residual concept/relationship shift. This does NOT prove causality and does NOT establish that concept shift is the only source of transfer failure; AUC below 0.5 is a direction, not poor performance, and is never inverted.

landcover_exclusion_reason: landcover_dominant is categorical; its integer class codes have no scientifically meaningful scalar ordering, so a raw-code ROC-AUC would be invalid. Reported as a separate descriptive table instead.

step9f_model_level_integration.note: Step9F reports model/representation-level ranking reversal across feature variants, NOT per-feature univariate direction. It is presented at the model level only and is never joined per-feature.
